test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following substances is an alloy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bronze.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bronze contain Copper 90%, Tin 10%.

 
 
• It is an alloy of Copper and Tin.
 
 
 
• Uses of Bronze - In the making of coins, ornaments, utensils, and statues.
 
• An alloy is a substance made by melting two or more elements together, at least one of them is metal.
